test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

S T _ _ S _ M Z _ T M Z S _ _ Z

options.text: T S T S Z M
M T S Z T M
M Z T S T M
M Z T S Z M

solution:
Given sequence: S T _ _ S _ M Z _ T M Z S _ _ Z

 
• T S T S Z M → S T **T S** - S **T** M Z - **S** T M Z - S **Z** **M** Z
 
• M T S Z T M → S T **M T** - S **S** M Z - **Z** T M Z - S **T** **M** Z
 
• M Z T S T M → S T **M Z** - S **T** M Z - **S** T M Z - S **T M** Z
 
• M Z T S Z M → S T **M Z** - S **T** M Z - **S** T M Z - S **Z M** Z

 
• In option 3, **STMZ** is repeated.

Hence, '**M Z T S T M**' is the correct answer.
